source_snapshot_contract: reachable clean source commit/tree captured before output deletion; generated artifact is not recursively hashed
artifact_commit_contract: commit this generated directory as a separate child of source_revision

timing_scope.candidate_generation_ms: route enumeration and f64 solves; excludes fixture/exact-geometry setup and compilation
timing_scope.current_minimasafe_ms: ordinary MinimaSafe aggregation/fallback; excludes candidate generation and compilation
timing_scope.retained_exact_ms: exact resolution of every retained candidate; excludes candidate generation and compilation
timing_scope.exact_all_reference_ms: complete supplied-stream exact enumeration, solving, and sorting; excludes fixture setup and compilation
timing_scope.analysis_validation: Python analysis/validation and compilation are excluded from all row timers
